Investigators have recovered the flight data and cockpit voice recorders as the FAA and NTSB begin their investigation into the incident.

A letter sent on behalf of the King reiterated that their status as private citizens will be fully respected, maintaining the couple's decision to step down as senior working royals in January 2020. This one-kilometer bridge marks a significant development in the relationship between the two countries, which has strengthened notably since the onset of the Ukraine war in 2022. Both nations have been enhancing their military and economic ties during this period.

The two-lane crossing, about one kilometer long, is connected to a new border point that Russian authorities say can process up to 300 vehicles a day. Until now, the neighbors had rail and air links but no road crossing, expanding the infrastructure available for cross-border travel and freight.
